What’s on this week?
Saturdays 10.30–11.30am
Toddler time

At Paraparaumu Library – Join us for a fun and relaxed toddler hangout with stories, songs, and free play.

Saturdays 11.00am–12.00pm
Reading to dogs

With Gryphon – Join us at Paraparaumu library, settle in with a good book and a very good listener.

Saturdays and Sundays
SPLASH!

At Ōtaki and Coastlands pool – 1pm–4.30pm. Inflatable fun for the whole family!

Sundays, 8am–10am
Low Sensory Session

At Coastlands Aquatic Centre –enjoy low sensory and low noise in our deliciously warm programmes pool. 

Tuesdays, 10.30am–11.15am
Pēpi time at the pool

At Coastlands Aquatic Centre – Bring your little one to our drop-in sessions to build their water confidence in a safe and warm environment.

Wednesdays, 10.30am–11.15am
Pēpi time at the pool

At Ōtaki pool – Bring your little one to our drop-in sessions to build their water confidence in a safe and warm environment.

15 July 2026, 6-8pm
Paraparaumu – Prioritise Kāpiti event

Drop in to Paraparaumu Library Iver Trask Place, Paraparaumu, to talk with elected members about our proposed priorities and planning principles for the Long-term Plan 2027–37.

18 July 2026, 10am-12pm
Drop-in session | Paekākāriki

Drop in to Paekākāriki Library (in the Paekākāriki Tennis Club)
14 Wellington Road, Paekākāriki, to talk with elected members about our proposed priorities and planning principles for the Long-term Plan 2027–37.

13,15 & 17 July, 10.30am - 12.30pm
Multiple drop-in sessions | Coastlands Mall

Drop in to Lounge area by Rosetta Cafe
Coastlands Shopping Centre, to talk with elected members about our proposed priorities and planning principles for the Long-term Plan 2027–37.
